headline: Base Fighting Shifts Across Divided Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement has shifted toward Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf. Godcrofts now reports 24 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including four in the latest two, while its current ledger shows all nine bases Colonial-held; the recent record nevertheless includes neutralizations and captures by both factions. Stlican Shelf has risen to 44 events, with five in the newest two hours, and remains divided eight Warden to one Colonial. Weathered Expanse has eased from its earlier burst, recording 55 events in 24 hours but none in the latest two; its ledger stands six Warden to three Colonial. Linn Mercy likewise has 20 events but no fresh movement in two hours, holding five Warden and six Colonial bases. Deadlands remains ten Colonial to one Warden, though its 13-event day has gone quiet recently and casualty rates are cooling. Fisherman’s Row posts 15 events, chiefly around Arcadia and Eidolo, but no movement in the latest two hours. Callahan’s Passage, Stonecradle, Marban Hollow, and Viper Pit remain notable in the wider ledger, while most other sectors show no recent base changes.
